Bug_Title: RV: Bad attempt to compute absolute value of signed random integer (RV_ABSOLUTE_VALUE_OF_RANDOM_INT)
Bug_Details:
This code generates a random signed integer and then computes
the absolute value of that random integer.  If the number returned by the random number
generator is Integer.MIN_VALUE, then the result will be negative as well (since
Math.abs(Integer.MIN_VALUE) == Integer.MIN_VALUE). (Same problem arises for long values as well).
 Integer.MIN_VALUE Math.abs(Integer.MIN_VALUE) == Integer.MIN_VALUE
Bug_Explanation: The bug was embedded by using the Math.abs() function to compute the absolute value of a signed random integer. This causes the value to be negative if the random integer is equal to Integer.MIN_VALUE.
Trigger_Explanation: The test method triggers the bug by calling the showBug() method, which generates a random signed integer and then computes the absolute value of that random integer. If the number returned by the random number generator is Integer.MIN_VALUE, then the result will be negative as well (since Math.abs(Integer.MIN_VALUE) == Integer.MIN_VALUE).
